required_data_attribution.PPIKB: Derived from PPIKB, Zhu et al.(2026), DOI10.1038/s41597-026-07962-1, https://ppikb.duanlab.ac/ and its downloads, database CC BY4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Frozen source fetched2026-10-15; original source file hashes retained. Changes: canonicalization, exact-KD eligibility filters, unit normalization and pKD transformation, exclusions, source/family connected-component grouping, and fixed train/validation/test splits. No endorsement is implied.
required_data_attribution.PEPBI: Torres, Pantazes and Kieslich(2025), Dryad DOI10.5061/dryad.wstqjq2wk, dataset CC0; cite associated article10.1038/s41597-025-05754-7.
required_data_attribution.RT: PXD064311, frozen official PRIDE project/license metadata; target-only measured pH9 March RT diagnostic, CC0. This is not the held original cross-condition RT benchmark.
required_data_attribution.B1: ELM provenance and non-commercial agreement retained; do not bundle its records/descriptions in a generic permissive release.

raw_prediction_gold_policy.A1: May publish original numeric pKD gold/sample IDs alongside own predictions as a PPIKB-derived data artifact under its database attribution terms; no additional row-level restriction observed in the audited frozen fields. Do not label inherited gold as first-party MIT.
raw_prediction_gold_policy.B1_ELM: Unknown/restricted independently of paper open access; omit gold/labels/descriptions from unrestricted package until ELM agreement conditions resolved.
raw_prediction_gold_policy.RT_PXD064311: CC0 measured values may be included with source citation and snapshot SHA.
raw_prediction_gold_policy.unknown_sources: No blanket permission claimed; metadata/derived aggregate metrics without copied third-party expressive text are the default.
raw_prediction_gold_policy.evaluation_acceptance_independent: Redistribution license does not turn unaccepted runs into valid benchmark results; preserve failed/missing/status metadata.

public_index_privacy: Public index uses relative paths and omits URL access-token/view_only queries; do not copy raw internal manifests containing machine paths, credentials or access capabilities without separate publication sanitization.

audit_checks.old_manifest_failures_not_treated_as_fin: PEPBI recovered current file separately indexed; do not infer unavailable from historical failed attempt
